title: Relative uses ChatGPT to navigate literature during FOLFIRINOX; pancreatic liver metastases regress, contribution undetermined
summary: A dentist nephew in Baku used ChatGPT, later GPT-5, to summarize literature and weigh off-label add-ons for a 65-year-old on FOLFIRINOX; 11 liver metastases regressed; the author cannot attribute it.
account: Khalil (International Medical Case Reports Journal, 2026) is a dentist and the patient's nephew writing as sole author. He reports a 65-year-old with metastatic pancreatic adenosquamous carcinoma and 11 hepatic metastases treated with FOLFIRINOX. The patient and author added high-dose intravenous vitamin C, doxycycline and later azithromycin as off-label home measures. After three cycles magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) showed complete radiological regression of the hepatic lesions, confirmed around the sixth cycle. Chemotherapy stopped after six cycles. Ursodeoxycholic acid in late September 2025 resolved cholestasis. The author and patient used ChatGPT, initially an earlier model and later GPT-5. They used it to search and summarize literature, interpret CA 19–9 during cholestasis and appraise data on adjunctive interventions. The author writes that GPT “materially influenced how we navigated information”. He also states that the single case cannot determine the contribution of those interventions to the response. No attributable change in diagnosis or treatment can be established from the sources on record. The clinical course ran through 2025.
purpose: Patient-side literature navigation and summarization during cancer treatment
deployer: The patient's nephew (Uzman Dent, Baku) with the patient
location: Baku, Azerbaijan (surgery and pathology performed in Turkey)
segment: Patients and families navigating cancer care
taxonomy_note: The AI's part was literature summary; the metastasis regression is not attributed.

ratings.reason: Complete radiological regression occurred on FOLFIRINOX. But the author states the case cannot determine the contribution of the model-informed adjuncts.

ai_role.statement: ChatGPT's role, per the author, was literature navigation and summarization that shaped which supportive options the family considered. The author reports no efficacy claim and warns that outputs may be incorrect. The outcome is not attributable to the model.
